h1: Morning affirmations: 50 phrases to start your day well
description: 50 morning affirmations for energy, calm and confidence, plus a simple 2-minute routine to make them a daily habit that actually sticks.
lead: Morning affirmations are short, positive sentences you say to yourself in the first minutes of the day. They set the tone before emails and news do. Here are 50 to choose from, and a 2-minute routine to make them stick.
card: 50 phrases for energy, calm and confidence, and a 2-minute routine.
image_alt: The Today screen of Daily Affirmations showing a morning affirmation
app_text: Daily Affirmations gives you a fresh set every morning, a gentle reminder at the time you pick, and a widget so today's affirmation is the first thing you see when you unlock your phone.
faq: When is the best time to say morning affirmations?
Within the first 30 minutes after waking, before you check messages or news. Pairing them with something you already do, like brushing your teeth or making coffee, makes the habit far easier to keep.
How many morning affirmations should I say?
Three to five is plenty. A few sentences you actually mean work better than a long list you rush through.
Should I say affirmations out loud?
Out loud is best if you can, because hearing your own voice makes the words more concrete. Whispering, writing them down or reading them slowly in your head also works.
How long until morning affirmations make a difference?
Most people notice a calmer, more intentional start to the day within one or two weeks of daily practice. Treat it like any habit: consistency matters more than intensity.

title: How to Write Affirmations That Feel True (With Examples)
h1: How to write affirmations that actually feel true
description: A simple 5-step method to write your own affirmations, with before-and-after examples, common mistakes to avoid and a fill-in template.
lead: A good affirmation is short, positive, in the present tense, and believable to you today. That last part is where most affirmations fail. This guide walks you through a 5-step method, with examples you can copy and adapt.
card: A 5-step method, before-and-after examples and a fill-in template.
image_alt: The Favorites screen of Daily Affirmations with saved affirmations
app_text: Not ready to write your own yet? Daily Affirmations has hundreds of affirmations across categories like confidence, gratitude and calm. Save the ones that feel true as favorites, then use them as a starting point for your own.
faq: Do affirmations have to be in the present tense?
Usually yes. "I am" and "I can" statements feel more immediate than "I will". If a present-tense statement feels like a lie, use a bridge phrase such as "I am learning to" or "I am open to".
How long should an affirmation be?
One short sentence, ideally under 12 words. If you can't remember it without reading it, it's too long.
What if my affirmation feels fake?
That's a sign it's too far from where you are now. Make it smaller and more specific, or add a bridge phrase. "I am confident" can become "I am getting more comfortable speaking up".
How many affirmations should I write?
Start with three that cover what matters most to you right now. You can always add more later, and you can rotate them every few weeks.

title: Self-Love Affirmations: 50 Kind Things to Tell Yourself
h1: Self-love affirmations: 50 kind things to tell yourself
description: 50 self-love affirmations for hard days, self-worth, your body and setting boundaries, plus tips to make them feel true instead of forced.
lead: Self-love affirmations are kind sentences you say to yourself on purpose, especially on days when your inner voice is harsh. Below are 50, grouped by situation, and a few tips to make them feel true instead of forced.
card: 50 affirmations for hard days, self-worth, your body and boundaries.
image_alt: Swiping through self-love affirmations in Daily Affirmations
app_text: Self Love is one of the free categories in Daily Affirmations. Swipe through a new set each day, save the ones that land as favorites, and share them as cards with someone who needs them too.
faq: What are self-love affirmations?
Short, positive statements about your worth, your needs and how you treat yourself, such as "I am allowed to take up space". You repeat them to practise a kinder way of talking to yourself.
Do self-love affirmations work?

They tend to help most when they are believable and repeated daily. Research on self-affirmation suggests that reflecting on your values can reduce defensiveness and stress. They are a support, not a replacement for professional help when you need it.
What if I don't believe self-love affirmations yet?
Start with softer versions. "I am working on accepting myself" is easier to believe than "I love everything about myself", and it is still a step in the right direction.
How often should I say self-love affirmations?
Once a day is a good start, for example in the morning or before bed. Many people also keep one ready for hard moments, like after a mistake.

title: Affirmations for Anxiety: 40 Calming Phrases
description: 40 affirmations for anxiety: for anxious moments, overthinking, social situations and sleepless nights, plus 5 steps to use them when worry hits.
lead: Affirmations for anxiety are short, calming sentences you can repeat when worry takes over, to slow down and remind yourself you are safe right now. Here are 40, grouped by situation, and a simple way to use them in the moment.
card: 40 calming phrases for anxious moments, worry, social situations and nights.
image_alt: Daily Affirmations widgets on the iPhone Home Screen
app_text: Daily Affirmations brings you a fresh set every morning, so calming words become familiar before you need them. Peace is a free category, Anxiety Relief is part of Premium, and a Home Screen widget keeps one steady sentence in sight all day.
faq: Do affirmations help with anxiety?

They can help many people feel steadier in anxious moments, especially when the words are believable and practised daily. They work as a support alongside other habits like slow breathing, not as a treatment. If anxiety affects your daily life, speak to a doctor or therapist.
What is a good affirmation for anxiety?
Short, honest sentences work best, such as "This feeling is uncomfortable, and it will pass" or "I am safe right now". They acknowledge the feeling instead of arguing with it.
When should I say affirmations for anxiety?
Practise them once a day when you're calm, for example in the morning, so they're familiar. Then use one or two in the moment, paired with slow breaths, when you notice worry building.
What if affirmations make my anxiety worse?
That usually means the sentence feels too far from how you feel. Soften it with a phrase like "I am learning to" or "Right now, I", or try a grounding exercise first and come back to the words later.

description: 40 affirmations for confidence at work, with people and after setbacks, plus a simple 7-day practice to make self-belief feel real.
lead: Affirmations for confidence are short sentences that remind you what you're capable of, so you act from self-trust instead of doubt. Here are 40, grouped by situation, and a 7-day practice that turns them into real confidence.

app_text: Confidence is one of the free categories in Daily Affirmations. Get a fresh set every morning, save the ones that feel true as favorites, and watch your streak grow as the habit builds.
faq: Do affirmations for confidence work?

They help most when they are believable and paired with action. Repeating a sentence like "I've done hard things before" before a challenge can quiet self-doubt enough to try, and each small success makes the next affirmation easier to believe.
What is a good confidence affirmation?
One that feels a little stretching but still true, such as "I trust myself to figure this out" or "I am becoming more confident every day". Avoid extreme statements you immediately argue with.
How often should I say confidence affirmations?
Once a day as a habit, for example in the morning, and again right before a moment that tests your confidence, like a meeting, a presentation or a difficult conversation.
Can affirmations help with self-doubt at work?
Yes, as one tool among several. Use them to reframe the inner critic before high-pressure moments, and back them up with preparation and small brave actions, like speaking up once per meeting.

description: 50 gratitude affirmations for everyday life, the people you love, yourself and hard days, plus a simple 5-minute daily gratitude practice.

app_text: Gratitude and Abundance are both free categories in Daily Affirmations. Get a fresh set every morning, save the ones that feel true as favorites, and share one as a card with someone you're thankful for.
faq: What are gratitude affirmations?
Short, positive sentences in the present tense that name something you're thankful for, such as "I am grateful for the people who love me as I am". They help you notice what's already going well.
When should I say gratitude affirmations?

Whenever you'll remember them: many people like the morning to set the tone for the day, others prefer the evening to look back on it. Attaching them to an existing habit, like your first coffee, makes them easier to keep.
How many gratitude affirmations should I use?
Two or three at a time is plenty. A few you actually feel work better than a long list you rush through. Swap them out when they start to feel automatic.
Is it okay to practice gratitude on a bad day?
Yes, as long as it doesn't become a way to dismiss how you feel. Acknowledge the hard part first, then look for one small thing that helped. Being grateful and struggling can both be true at once.
What's the difference between a gratitude journal and gratitude affirmations?
A journal records specific things you're thankful for. An affirmation turns one of them into a sentence you repeat. They work well together: write three things, then say one as an affirmation.

title: Affirmations for Sleep: 45 Calming Phrases for Bedtime
h1: Affirmations for sleep: 45 calming phrases for bedtime
description: 45 affirmations for sleep to let go of the day, relax your body and quiet a busy mind, plus a simple 10-minute bedtime routine.
lead: Affirmations for sleep are slow, gentle sentences you repeat as you wind down, so your mind has something calm to hold instead of replaying the day. Here are 45, including a few for kids, and a 10-minute bedtime routine.
card: 45 calming phrases to let go of the day, relax and drift off, and a 10-minute routine.
image_alt: Daily Affirmations widgets on the iPhone Home Screen
app_text: Rest and Peace are both free categories in Daily Affirmations. Set your daily reminder for the evening if bedtime suits you best, save the calming ones as favorites, and keep one on your Lock Screen with a widget.
faq: Do affirmations help you sleep?

They can help you wind down. Repeating a calm sentence gives a busy mind something slow to focus on instead of replaying the day. They aren't a treatment for sleep problems, so if you have trouble sleeping most nights, talk to a doctor.
When should I say sleep affirmations?
In the last few minutes before sleep, once you're lying down and your phone is away. Saying them as part of the same short routine each night makes them a signal that it's time to rest.
Should I say bedtime affirmations out loud?
You don't need to. At night a slow whisper or a silent repeat works well, especially if you share a room. Matching each one to a long breath out helps you relax.
Can I listen to sleep affirmations instead of saying them?
Yes, if that's what relaxes you. Some people prefer to read or say a few themselves because it keeps the words personal and avoids having a screen or speaker on in bed.
What are good bedtime affirmations for kids?
Short and comforting ones, such as "I am safe, and I am loved" or "I did my best today". Say them together as part of the bedtime routine.

description: 50 affirmations for work to start the day, stay focused, handle stress and difficult conversations, and switch off, plus a 5-minute workday routine.
lead: Affirmations for work are short sentences that help you start the day with intention, stay focused under pressure and actually switch off afterwards. Here are 50, grouped by moment, and a simple routine that fits around your workday.
card: 50 phrases for focus, stressful days, meetings and switching off, and a simple routine.
image_alt: A gentle daily reminder from the Daily Affirmations app
app_text: Daily Affirmations sends one gentle reminder a day at the time you pick, so you can set it for just before work. Motivation and Confidence are free categories, while Career and Focus are part of Premium. Save the ones that help as favorites and keep one in a widget between meetings.
faq: What are good affirmations for work?

Practical ones that describe how you want to act today, such as "I give my full attention to one task at a time" or "I can ask for help". They're easier to believe than big statements about success, so they're more useful in the moment.
When should I say work affirmations?
Before you start (ideally before you open email), at a stress point like a deadline or tough meeting, and when you finish to help you switch off. One or two at each moment is plenty.
Can affirmations help with work stress?

They can help you pause and respond more calmly to everyday pressure. They don't fix an unfair workload or a difficult workplace, so if stress is constant, talk to your manager, HR or someone you trust.
How do I use affirmations at work without anyone noticing?
Say them silently, write one at the top of your daily notes, keep a sticky note on your monitor, or use a phone widget. Nobody needs to know.
What's a good affirmation for a Monday?
Try "This is a fresh day and a fresh start" or "I start today with one clear priority". Pick your most important task for the week, then say it before you begin.

app_text: Daily Affirmations is made for grown-ups, but it's a handy source for parents and teachers. Save the affirmations that suit your family as favorites, share them as cards, and keep a daily habit of your own so your kids see you do it too.
faq: What are positive affirmations for kids?
Short, simple sentences children repeat to themselves, such as "I can do hard things" or "Mistakes help me learn". They help kids build a kinder, more confident way of talking to themselves.
At what age can kids start using affirmations?

Even preschoolers can say very short ones like "I am brave" or "I am loved" together with a parent. From around school age, kids can choose their own, and teens often prefer writing them down privately.
When is the best time to say affirmations with kids?
Attach them to something you already do every day: the school run, breakfast or bedtime. One minute is plenty.
How do I get my child to say affirmations?
Do it together, keep it playful and let them choose. An affirmation jar, mirror talk or decorated cards make it feel like a game rather than a task.
Can affirmations help a child with anxiety?

They can be a comforting everyday habit, especially paired with slow breathing. They aren't a treatment, so if worries last for weeks or get in the way of daily life, talk to their teacher, school counselor or doctor.

title: Affirmations for Healing: 50 Gentle Phrases for Hard Times
h1: Affirmations for healing: 50 gentle phrases for hard times
description: 50 affirmations for emotional healing after a breakup, loss or a hard past, plus a gentle 7-day practice and tips to make them feel true.
lead: Affirmations for healing are gentle, honest sentences that help you be kinder to yourself while you recover from a breakup, a loss or old hurt. Here are 50, grouped by what you're going through, and a small 7-day practice to start with.
card: 50 gentle phrases for the past, heartbreak, grief and moving forward.
image_alt: Swiping through affirmations in the Daily Affirmations app
app_text: Self Love, Peace and Fresh Start are free categories in Daily Affirmations, and Resilience is part of Premium. A fresh set arrives every morning, so you always have a kind sentence ready. Save the ones that help as favorites to come back to on harder days.
faq: Do affirmations for healing work?

They can make the healing process feel gentler by replacing harsh self-talk with kinder, more honest words. They don't change what happened or replace support from people and professionals, but many people find them a steadying daily habit.
What is a good healing affirmation?
One that is honest about where you are, such as "I am allowed to heal at my own pace" or "Healing isn't linear, and that's okay". Avoid sentences that pretend everything is fine.
How long does it take for healing affirmations to help?
There's no fixed timeline. Some people feel a little calmer within days of a daily practice, for others it's more gradual. Consistency and patience matter more than how many you say.
Can affirmations help with grief?
They can help you hold grief more gently, for example "There is no right way to grieve". Grief has its own timeline, and talking to people you trust or a grief counselor can help too.
Are affirmations a replacement for therapy?
No. They're a supportive habit you can use alongside therapy or other help. If pain feels overwhelming or isn't easing, reach out to a professional.

title: Affirmations for Success: 50 Phrases to Reach Your Goals
h1: Affirmations for success: 50 phrases to reach your goals
description: 50 affirmations for success for your mindset, goals, setbacks and career, plus a 5-minute daily routine that ties affirmations to real action.
lead: Affirmations for success are short sentences that keep your mind on your goals and your effort, especially when progress is slow. Here are 50, grouped by what you're working on, and a 5-minute routine that turns them into daily action.
card: 50 phrases for goals, setbacks, career and success with balance.

app_text: Motivation, Growth and Abundance are free categories in Daily Affirmations, and Career and Purpose are part of Premium. A fresh set arrives every morning, your streak shows how consistent you've been, and a widget keeps your favorite in sight while you work.
faq: Do affirmations for success really work?

They work as a mindset tool, not as magic. Repeating a sentence like "I take one action toward my goal every day" keeps your attention on your goal and makes it easier to act. The results still come from the actions you take.
What is a good affirmation for success?
One tied to effort and growth, such as "My effort today builds my results tomorrow" or "I finish what I start". These stay believable even on days when results are slow.
When should I say success affirmations?
In the morning before you plan your day works well, and again before an important task, meeting or decision. Pair each one with a concrete action.
How do I stay motivated when success takes a long time?
Track small steps and review them weekly, celebrate milestones, and use affirmations for setbacks on hard days. Consistency matters more than motivation.
Can affirmations help with fear of failure?
They can help you reframe it, for example "Failure is feedback, not a final verdict". Taking small, low-risk steps alongside them is what builds real confidence over time.
